metadata.title: That 1 kill where I aimed at nothing and Valorant said ‘Sure, take it and run’
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just cash in on enemy confusion?
They must’ve been too busy uninstalling.
Click if your aim’s a glitch but kills still happen.
Valorant logic is peak nonsense again.

Tap if your best kills come from pure chaos!

#valorant #luckshot #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
